Event

Healing Thru Art

Thu, Jul 23, 2020 · 5:00 PM · MartinPatrick3

When
Thu, Jul 23, 2020 · 5:00 PM
Where
MartinPatrick3
212 3rd Ave N Ste 106, Minneapolis, MN
Cost
Free

MartinPatrick3 presents Healing Thru Art a weekend presenting the best art and locally made goods from our community This fundraiser will be highlighting and benefiting artists and entrepreneurs of color.

Proceeds will benefit two amazing local non-profits, Hallie Q. Brown and ROHO Collective. More specifically, 20% of profits from the guest vendors and artists will be donated to Hallie Q. Brown and ROHO Collective.

RSVP On Facebook Now

MartinPatrick3 will be hosting an online and in-person fundraiser, where 100% of proceeds will be donated to these two wonderful nonprofits. Stay tuned for our online fundraiser announcement!

***This event will be both online (through our Instagram) and in-person. It will be open house style, and we will maintaining social distancing guidelines as well as requiring masks for all guests. Celebrate the arts community with us safely!

THURSDAY – Meet the artists.
FRIDAY – Art exhibition and makers market.
SATURDAY – Art exhibition and makers market.
SUNDAY – Kid’s Day with interactive art opportunities and grab bag for kids. Art exhibition and makers market.

Hallie Q Brown has served the community for 91 years providing access to critical human services, fostering and promoting personal growth, and developing community leadership.

ROHO Collective
Serving both emerging and professional artists of color by providing a place for development in technical skills, professional growth, and business opportunities.
